description: Only how to use, configure and run fast-question. No development history, decision history or internal implementation.

items.question: What query syntax does the fast-question search box accept?
items.answer:
Words separated by spaces find only items that contain all of them (AND). The ? button next to the search box shows the same table.
- a | b: items that contain either one (OR)
- -a: leave out items that contain a
- "a b": a phrase that includes the space
- q:a · a:a: search only questions · only answers
- path:x: items whose evidence file path contains x

items.question: When does fast-question show similar results for a search with 0 hits?
items.answer:
They appear separately only when exact, synonym and morpheme search all return 0 hits.
- Items sharing at least 50% of the search term's 2-character pieces
- Or items matching at least 50% of the search term's morphemes

items.question: How do I search fast-question with a regular expression?
items.answer:
The search box on the screen has no regular expressions; only Claude can use them, with regex=true on MCP kb_search.
- Up to 200 characters, nested repetition such as (a+)+ is refused

items.question: What keyboard shortcuts does the fast-question screen have?
items.answer:
/ moves to the search box, and the up and down arrows move through results and expand them.
- Enter: expand the first result from the search box
- E: edit the expanded item
- Esc: closes syntax help, then collapses the expanded item, then clears the search term, category filter and 24-hour view, one at a time
- While editing, Ctrl+Enter saves and Esc cancels

items.question: What happens when I delete a Q&A in fast-question?
items.answer:
It disappears from search results, and the row is kept so it can be brought back.
- Undo in the notice right after deleting (6 seconds) restores it
- After that, ask Claude to restore it (MCP kb_restore)

items.question: What happens when I delete a category in fast-question?
items.answer:
Its subcategories and the Q&As in them are deleted together.
- The confirmation shows how many subcategories and items will be deleted
- There is no way to bring back the category itself
- Its Q&As can be restored with kb_restore by choosing a category to move them to

items.question: What are the length and line limits for fast-question questions and answers?
items.answer:
A question is one line of up to 300, and an answer up to 800 and 6 lines (weighted length: Hangul and CJK count 2, other characters 1).
- Category name: 60 characters, > is not allowed
- Items added by Claude: each answer line up to 240, the first line 1-2 sentences, '- ' items from the second line

items.question: How do I add or find Q&As in fast-question with Claude?
items.answer:
Ask the connected Claude with words like "save this as a Q&A" or "look it up in qa".
- Claude Code plugin: /fast-question:qa to add, /fast-question:qa <search term> to find
- claude.ai and Desktop: add http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp as a custom connector to use the kb_* tools
- The Claude panel on the screen uses the same tools

items.question: How do I build fast-question Q&As from a project folder at once?
items.answer:
Run /fast-question:qa-harvest <path> in the Claude Code plugin.
- Adds up to 60 items per run and 5 per file
- From the second run, only files changed since the last build are covered
- It reads folders on your PC, so claude.ai, Desktop and the Claude panel on the screen cannot run it

items.question: When does the fast-question instant question hook run?
items.answer:
When you type a question into Claude Code (question mark, question ending or question word, up to 300 characters and 4 lines), it searches the KB and adds the results to that turn.
- Requests that ask for work are not treated as questions
- If no Q&A matches and none is similar, it adds nothing to the turn
- When asked from a project folder that is in the KB and files were read to answer, the Stop hook explains the add conditions after the turn ends
- Other everyday questions are not added

items.question: How are fast-question cleanup items found and handled?
items.answer:
A periodic job finds items worth fixing once a day, and Claude cleans them up.
- Targets: items with similar questions, rule violations in items Claude added, items whose evidence changed or could not be checked
- Claude Code plugin: when Claude meets a marked item during a search, it fixes or archives it without asking
- claude.ai connector, one-line connection and the Claude panel on the screen: Claude fixes items only when you ask or agree
- To clean up all at once, ask Claude "clean up qa"
- The periodic job itself does not change items

items.question: How do I add synonyms or proper nouns to fast-question search?
items.answer:
Ask Claude to add them with MCP kb_dict_edit (the screen has no dictionary management).
- Another spelling with the same meaning: action=synonym_add
- Proper nouns that morpheme analysis splits wrongly: the operator adds them, because it is a server-wide dictionary
- See the current dictionary: kb_dict_get

items.question: How do I connect Claude Code to the fast-question remote server?
items.answer:
Run the commands of step 1 (Connect with one line) or step 2 (Install on this PC) from Connect at the top of the screen in a terminal, in order.
- Step 1: register with claude mcp add --transport http, then sign in and approve in /mcp; file evidence is not available
- Step 2: the plugin installs the Skills, the instant question hook and the MCP server; the PC needs uv, and uvx fast-question login signs in
- With step 2, remove the step 1 entry with claude mcp remove -s user fast-question

items.question: How do I open the fast-question web screen?
items.answer:
Open http://127.0.0.1:8765 and sign in with a GitHub or Google account.
- Sign out: next to the account name at the top of the screen

items.question: How do I download my fast-question remote account data or delete the account?
items.answer:
Use the Connect panel at the top of the screen.
- Export: downloads your whole KB as one SQLite file (it opens as is in local mode)
- Delete account: type the confirmation word delete at the bottom of the panel and press the button; all sign-ins and tokens of this account stop working

items.question: How do I give Claude work from the fast-question screen?
items.answer:
Open the right-hand panel with the Claude button at the top, register an Anthropic API key, then chat.
- The key is kept encrypted on the server, and Delete key below the panel removes it
- Models: Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5
- It searches, adds, edits, archives, adds and renames categories, and cleans up; deleting a category is done in category editing
- The chat history stays only in this browser tab

items.question: How do I disconnect a Claude app or a personal token from fast-question?
items.answer:
Disconnect it in the Connect panel at the top of the screen.
- Connected apps: one-line connections and claude.ai connectors (name, connected time, last use), with Disconnect
- Tokens: personal tokens made by plugin sign-in and the like, with Revoke
- A disconnected app must connect again to use this DB

items.question: What are the storage limits of a fast-question remote account?
items.answer:
Up to 20,000 Q&As, 500 categories, 100,000 evidence rows (deleted ones included) and a 200 MB DB file.
- Over 200 MB, writes other than archive, restore and disconnect are blocked
- 10 personal tokens and 20 OAuth connections (beyond that, the connection unused the longest is disconnected)

items.question: When and where are fast-question backups made?
items.answer:
The server makes a copy on the server for each account DB when 24 hours have passed since the last backup.
- Only the latest few are kept
- For a copy you keep yourself, use Export in the Connect panel

items.question: What does the fast-question evidence state stale mean?
items.answer:
It means a file attached as evidence to a Q&A changed after it was recorded.
- The server cannot read the file, so Claude on the PC that added the evidence checks it with kb_recheck and reports
- If you use the repository, scripts\autostart.py --check-install checks it every day at 09:00
- With no check for over 30 days, the state becomes unknown

items.question: How do I copy an answer or an item address on the fast-question screen?
items.answer:
When you expand an item, Copy and Copy address buttons are at the end of the history line.
- Copy: copies the question and answer together as two lines, Q: and A:
- Address format: http://127.0.0.1:8765/#qa/<id>

items.question: How do I see only the fast-question Q&As added in the last 24 hours?
items.answer:
Press the 'Last 24 hours: N' chip in the summary line.
- Press it again or press Esc to clear it
- The chip is hidden when nothing was added in that period

items.question: How do I export the Q&As of a fast-question category to a Markdown file?
items.answer:
Turn on category editing in the category panel and press the export button on that category's row.
- A top-level category is exported with a section for each subcategory
- Deleted items are left out

items.question: How do I search again when a fast-question search finds 0 hits?
items.answer:
If the search term has two or more words, chips show the hit count of each query with one word left out, and pressing one searches with that query.
- Similar results are shown as well
